notes:
Renaming now sticks. A background refresh could reset the name field while you were typing, so your new name was silently discarded — fixed.
Arrow keys move the text cursor while renaming, instead of jumping to another file. Enter commits, Esc cancels.
Folio now also looks for updates when you switch back to it, so a new version no longer waits until your next launch.
notesZh:
重命名现在能真正保存了。之前编辑时后台刷新会重置名字输入框，改完的名字被静默丢弃——已修复。
重命名时左右方向键是移动文本光标，不再跳去选中别的文件；回车确认，Esc 取消。
回到应用时也会检查更新，新版本不用等到下次启动才提示。
